notes.title: Update Details v.002
notes.notes:
Before telling you about the show, here are the new features of the v.002 update :


- New Menu
- New Outfit
- First temporary game mode (One Door)
- New menu settings (To modify the sounds)
- Bugs Fixes


And more...



Finally, get ready for the show on February 27th.

We can not tell you more at the moment (See you in a few days for more information)
